messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@clarionhealth.com>
Cc: tessa.morgan@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Handshake & Ops sprint — Pass to CS (Clarion Health)

Hi Marta,

Great to have Clarion across the finish line — appreciate the team's responsiveness on redlines. Per procurement's confirmation (copied above), we have a signed order for a 12-month Dedicated plan scoped to the initial MVP use cases we discussed. High level:

- Start date: 2027-08-16 (target)
- Initial models: redwood-4b-q8 and redwood-13b-fp16 for higher-throughput endpoints
- Monthly committed GPU hours: 9x V100-equivalent (reserved) with burst pool
- SLA: 99.9% with standard business-hour support; escalation path documented in SOW

I'm handing this to CS and implementation so they can run the 0→1 sprint that gets Clarion from sign to pilot acceptance. Key asks for handoff:

1) Assign primary CS owner and implementation lead.
2) Confirm kickoff cadence (we suggested 2x/wk for first 3 weeks).
3) Validate acceptance criteria in the attached MVP spreadsheet — Clarion expects inference latency < 250ms p95 for the short-form flows and sample rate-limited bursting for batch exports.

Attachments: SOW_Clarion_v3.pdf, MVP_acceptance_criteria.xlsx (minor edits from legal).

Internal notes for CS: Clarion will host sensitive PHI-adjacent token metadata; they need KMS integration and audit log forwarding into their Splunk instance. Procurement wants a staging window before prod cutover for an external audit team to validate retention settings.

Tessa / Karthik — please pick primary owners and reply with a proposed sprint0 schedule by EOD Wednesday (2027-08-04) so I can loop back to Clarion. Marta — feel free to add anything I missed.

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Thanks Marcus — congrats team!

Quick read and initial plan: happy to take primary CS ownership. I'll be lead for the customer success runbook and acceptance support. Karthik, can you own implementation (networking, KMS, staging) and the first two technical sessions?

I pulled a few clarifying questions for Clarion before we lock sprint dates:

- Marta: who on your side will be the technical point-of-contact for KMS and Splunk forwarding? (name + email)
- Are there any internal blackout dates for cutover/testing in August?
- For the latency target: do you have representative payload sizes and token lengths we should use for preflight testing?

Proposed kickoff slots (pick 1):
- Mon 2027-08-16, 10:00–11:15 PT — kickoff + security checklist
- Tue 2027-08-17, 08:00–09:00 PT — technical deep-dive (networking, KMS)

I'll draft a one-page sprint0 agenda and share by EOD tomorrow.

Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks Tessa — great, glad you're on it. A few internal clarifications and context for Karthik:

- Clarion's technical POC for infra is Jorge Alvarez (jorge.alvarez@clarionhealth.com). He'll be the person who will accept the Splunk ingestion and turn up the KMS key.
- Staging window: Clarion requested 48–72 hours in the week of 2027-08-23 for the external audit to validate retention/purge settings. We should plan the staging cutover no earlier than Aug 22 but target Aug 24 for smoke tests to allow audit on Aug 25–26.
- Compliance: they insisted on HSM-backed key (AWS CloudHSM). Karthik — confirm we have the integration checklist and any infra pre-reqs documented.
- Acceptance tweaks: the acceptance spreadsheet (attached) includes per-flow payload samples — the quick-response flow is max 256 tokens, batch export jobs average 4k tokens per document.

Action items I will take:
- Send Clarion the kickoff invite once we have a confirmed time.
- Share legal-approved SOW link with procurement contact.

Karthik — if you can confirm ownership and give a one-line risk summary (blocked, at-risk, on-track) we can message Clarion and lock dates.

Marcus
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MVP_acceptance_criteria.xlsx

Looping in specifics from implementation side — I will own the implementation workstream. Status and plan:

Ownership: Karthik Iyer (implementation lead) — karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Triage status: on-track (one dependency: confirmation of CloudHSM customer key availability).

Planned sprint0 milestones and owners:
- 2027-08-16: Kickoff (Tessa leads, Marcus intro, Clarion POC Jorge attends)
- 2027-08-17: Network & KMS deep dive (Karthik leads)
- 2027-08-18: Integration smoke tests (Redwood infra + Clarion staging)
- 2027-08-24: Staging cutover candidate for audit (target)
- 2027-08-25–26: Audit window (Clarion external auditors)

Risks / blocking items:
- Customer needs to confirm the CloudHSM key ARN or provisioning ETA by 2027-08-12 — without that we cannot complete HSM-backed encryption setup.
- Firewall rules: Clarion's network ops must open the listed egress ports to our staging cluster (I'll send the specific IP ranges in a follow-up).

Deliverables I'll own:
- Implementation checklist (network, KMS, certs) — due 2027-08-13
- Staging runbook and smoke test scripts — due 2027-08-20
- Post-acceptance rollback plan and cost/runbook for burst capacity — due 2027-09-01

Next steps: Marcus — please send the kickoff calendar hold once Tessa confirms the slot. Marta/Jorge — can you confirm the CloudHSM target date and any internal blackout windows?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Karthik Iyer
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
